Title: Oil Service & Multi-Point Inspection Summary
WorkPerformed: Drained 5.5L 0W-20 engine oil. Installed genuine OEM oil filter and fresh crush washer. Inspected fluid levels; belts; and engine air filter.
IssuesFound: Found minor surface corrosion on 12V battery negative post; alternator output stable at 14.2V.
Recommendations: Cleaned battery terminal and applied dielectric grease. Recommended air filter replacement in 10;000 km.

Title: Brake System Rotors & Pads Overhaul
WorkPerformed: Dismantled front brake assemblies. Lathed front brake rotors to smooth finish. Installed heavy-duty ceramic pads. Flushed brake fluid with DOT 4 fluid.
IssuesFound: Inner front brake pad was worn down to 2mm. Caliper slider pins had dried grease.
Recommendations: Lubricated caliper slides with high-temperature silicone grease. Post-service road test showed immediate and firm pedal bite.

Title: Air Conditioning & HVAC Diagnostic Report
WorkPerformed: Conducted electronic vacuum decay test. Recovered and refilled 550g R-134a refrigerant with fluorescent tracer dye. Replaced activated charcoal cabin air filter.
IssuesFound: Cabin filter was clogged with leaves and debris; restricting cabin airflow by ~40%. No condenser leaks detected.
Recommendations: A/C output temperature verified at 4.5°C at dash center vents. Climate control operation restored to optimal efficiency.
